tools.name: create_deck
tools.title: Create a PowerPoint deck
tools.description: Start building a finished, editable PowerPoint deck from a brief and, when the person has documents or data, their text as sources. Use when the person asks for a deck, a presentation or slides. Answers at once with a deck_id; the deck itself takes one to two minutes, so tell the person and check on it with get_deck when they ask. Spends credits from the person's Kinsy account: 40 up to 10 slides, 60 up to 16, 90 up to 25, plus 10 for each generated picture. Ask before building.

name.description: A label for the source, e.g. a file name.
name.title: Name

brief.description: Who the deck is for, what it must achieve, the points it must make, the tone.
brief.title: Brief

sources.description: Text of the user's documents or data to build from.
sources.title: Sources

slides.description: Target slide count; omit to let Kinsy choose (usually 10).
slides.title: Slides

research.description: Look things up on the web while planning.
research.title: Research

answers.description: Answers to Kinsy's clarifying questions, e.g. {"audience": "the board"}.
answers.title: Answers

skip_questions.description: Build straight from the brief without clarifying questions.
skip_questions.title: Skip Questions

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same value when retrying, so a retry returns the first deck and charges nothing.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

tools.name: get_deck
tools.title: Check a deck
tools.description: Check a deck by its deck_id: whether it is still building and how far along, or finished, with its title, slide count, a link to review and edit it on the web, and download links. Use when the person asks whether a deck is ready or wants its links. Reads only.

include_previews.description: Add links to images of the first six slides.
include_previews.title: Include Previews

include_quality.description: Add the claims that could not be matched to the sources.
include_quality.title: Include Quality

tools.name: export_deck
tools.title: Download a deck
tools.description: A fresh download link for a finished deck, valid for one hour. Use this when the user wants the file or an earlier link has expired.

format.description: pptx (editable, default), pdf, or png (a zip of slide images).
format.title: Format

tools.name: list_themes
tools.title: List deck themes
tools.description: The visual themes create_deck accepts. Use this when the user asks for a particular look; otherwise let Kinsy choose.
